Tooltip_CFP_BuildCenter: Builds one true vanilla water tile recognized by fishing and fishing nets, then automatically adds a varied vanilla shoreline to surrounding land. Existing water is never covered. Requires two full 10 L metal buckets of water (20 L total), a shovel or spade, and Carpentry 6.
Tooltip_CFP_FillTile: Fills one constructed pond center and automatically recalculates its shoreline. Requires two uses (half a bag) of dirt and a shovel or spade.
